purpose: Keep research moving if historical 1H for delisted PIT members is structurally unavailable from free sources, without pretending survivor-biased evidence is clean.

promotion_grade_path.name: FULL_PIT_INTRADAY
requirements: Use PIT membership and PIT daily price/volume semantics.

Raw 1H candidate-date coverage must satisfy the existing frozen acceptance contract: pair>=99.5%, monthly>=99%, no completely missing required symbol, >=95% per-symbol for symbols with >=20 required days, restored/delisted pair coverage>=99%.
Only this path may support a promotion-grade Stable replacement claim from historical backtest evidence.

fallback_path.name: V47S_SURVIVOR_SHADOW
fallback_path.trigger: Full PIT intraday acceptance fails specifically because historical 1H for delisted/replaced PIT members cannot be recovered from approved free sources.
construction: Keep the corrected PIT membership, PIT daily price, PIT daily volume, identity epochs, canonical next-open target, frozen V11 architecture and exact NOCAP/CAP1000 policies.
Restrict model materialization to symbols for which raw 1H history is actually available; do not fabricate or interpolate missing intraday bars.
Report the omitted restored/delisted daily-eligible symbol-date share for each arm, H1/H2 separately, before opening returns.
Run the same H1 development and winner-only H2 mechanics only as research/shadow evidence.
interpretation: May be used to compare architecture behavior, NOCAP vs CAP1000 directionally, concentration, and whether the corrected target still has edge.
Must not finalize the price-cap policy solely from this shadow backtest.
Any candidate emerging from shadow evidence requires forward-live validation on the then-current complete universe before production replacement.

forward_validation.role: Clean path around historical delisted-1H unavailability.
forward_validation.rule: Freeze candidate logic before forward observations; collect current-universe signals and realized canonical returns prospectively. No retrospective deletion/tuning of failed forward signals.

prohibited: Do not lower the full-PIT 1H coverage thresholds after seeing results.
Do not treat missing delisted symbols as if they were ineligible merely because intraday data are unavailable.
Do not impute 1H bars from daily OHLC.
Do not promote from V47S_SURVIVOR_SHADOW alone.
Do not use 2026 historical returns to select a missing-data workaround.
